mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 86 degrees under clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School, with a moderate air quality index of 57. We are currently under a Waxing Gibbous moon, but unfortunately, there are no visible ISS passes tonight. Looking ahead, our overnight low will drop to 72 degrees, and please prepare for rain predicted throughout the night.

In city news, the I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students has officially closed for submissions. The City Clerk's office is shifting gears to the voting phase, which runs from July 28 through August 7, allowing the community to select designs that will appear on official stickers for the November election.

There is plenty to do around town, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can head over to Insight Wellness for yoga, and keep your calendars clear for trivia nights starting Monday at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

For our weekly report, we look back to July 13 when officers responded to a passerby report regarding a vehicle stuck on a large rock. The incident resulted in the driver, a 36-year-old Madison man, being arrested for an O-W-I.
Culver's is serving up their tasty Oreo Cookie Overload flavor today. They are open until 10 PM, so you still have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop before they close for the evening.
